title: Piermont Valley Acquisition Corp 8-K Filing — 2026-04-20
summary: Piermont Valley Acquisition Corp (CMCAU/CMCAF), a Cayman Islands-based blank check company, entered into a merger agreement on April 17, 2026 with Tigerless Health, Inc., a New York-based insurtech company founded in 2018. The transaction involves a two-step merger resulting in a combined entity (Pubco) with plans to list on Nasdaq. Tigerless shareholders will receive 5.6 million Class A and 22.4 million Class B shares; Piermont shareholders will receive approximately 5.95 million Class A shares assuming no redemptions.
key_points: Piermont Valley Acquisition Corp is a SPAC (special purpose acquisition company) with securities trading under CMCAU, CMCAF, and CMCAW.
Tigerless Health, Inc. is an insurtech company headquartered in New York City, founded in 2018, focused on data-driven insurance platform services.
The merger structure involves two sequential mergers: a reorganization merger (Tigerless into Merger Sub 1) followed by an acquisition merger (Piermont into Merger Sub 2).
Post-closing share distribution: Tigerless shareholders receive 5,600,000 Pubco Class A + 22,400,000 Pubco Class B shares; Piermont shareholders receive 5,952,886 Pubco Class A shares.
Pubco Class A common stock (Nasdaq listing target) has no voting rights; Class B shares have one vote per share and are not publicly traded.
Transaction closing is expected in the second half of 2026, subject to stockholder approvals and other conditions.
Existing Piermont warrants exercisable at $11.50 will convert into Pubco warrants.
Company is an emerging growth company as defined under SEC rules.
